_comment: Per-card faction corrections merged over cards.json at load time, applied after the box-derived faction index. Two reasons an entry exists: the card ships in a box tagged with more than one faction (or in no box at all), so buildFactionIndex cannot decide it; or its own faction field contradicts the box it ships in. Most entries were read off the card scans: the printed header band is the faction colour, sampled at 10-19% of card height across the full width. Validated against all 243 parts whose faction was already known: GoF 44/44, and no RDL/UN confusion in either direction. Discard "(D)" cards print grey by rule, so they inherit from their base card. Keys are card ids, values are faction codes (RDL, UN, GOF, PD, COLLABORATION).

ACE-01.why: Karl Fried is the exclusive pilot of the ACE-001 White Dwarf and ships in LAB_WHITE_DWARF, which the builder site lists under its COLLABORATION category alongside RDL, UN, GOF and PD. His card record is the only one of all 52 pilots whose faction disagrees with its box. Left as PD he cannot legally pilot the mech he is sold with, since parts and pilots are both faction-locked and the six White Dwarf parts read as COLLABORATION. PD most likely records Planetring Dynamics as the manufacturer rather than the play faction.

_corrections: UNSALE is "Unsale Content", a release-status label covering unreleased cards from several factions, not a PD-only box. Our boxes.json tagged it PD, which stamped PD on all 37 of its cards. 14 of them read RDL on the card front and are corrected here. 23 have no card scan at all, so they cannot be checked the same way and keep the box default; see the note below.
